entities.name: Mia
entities.description: A shepherd girl in a village on Lake Zhava, the daughter of a Skiltfolk slayer, who dreams of becoming a slayer herself and is eventually enthralled by the Gitrog.

entities.name: Wilbur
entities.description: A fisherman's apprentice who has just turned fifteen, Kalim's son and Mia's close friend; he believes in the Gitrog and joins the villagers' patrols.

entities.name: Kalim
entities.description: A barrel-chested village Elder and Wilbur's father who claims to have seen the Gitrog and leads the villagers in sacrifices to it.

entities.name: Veryl
entities.description: A fisherman with greasy blond hair who claims to have seen the Gitrog and who boasted of kissing an angel.

entities.name: Lehren
entities.description: An old fisherman who sells fish at the market and owns the ship used for the sacrifice.

entities.name: Olgard
entities.description: Mia's father, a famed Skiltfolk shieldbearer and slayer based in Drunau who left her behind.

entities.name: Sarah
entities.description: The blacksmith's wife, who once baked Mia cookies for her birthday and calls for her to be sacrificed.

entities.name: Kyle
entities.description: The cobbler's apprentice, one of the hooded villagers who attacks Mia.

entities.name: Terrance
entities.description: Veryl's younger brother, who attacks Mia with a sword.

entities.name: Verna
entities.description: A flower girl who charges Mia with a pitchfork.

entities.name: Ethan
entities.description: An Elder whose son is dragged under by the Gitrog.

entities.name: The Gitrog
entities.description: A giant, webbed, frog-like monster of Lake Zhava that drives people to sacrifice and swallows villagers whole with its tongue.

entities.name: Lake Zhava
entities.description: A dark, deep lake in the highlands of Nephalia near the Gavony border, home of the Gitrog.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: A region of Innistrad whose highlands hold Lake Zhava.

entities.name: Drunau
entities.description: A town where a branch of the Skiltfolk is based.

entities.name: Mia's Cabin
entities.description: Mia's cabin on a hill above the village, with a sheep pen beside it.

entities.name: Lehren's Ship
entities.description: A fair-sized fishing vessel on which the hooded villagers sail onto Lake Zhava.

entities.name: Skiltfolk
entities.description: An organization of slayers, one of whose branches is based in Drunau.

entities.name: Village Elders
entities.description: The ruling council of the lakeside village, who suspend fishing on the lake.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: The church that Kalim writes to for help but which sends no cathar or angel.

events.summary: Mia and Wilbur argue about whether the Gitrog is real; Wilbur lashes out about Mia's absent father, then they reconcile.
events.quote: Is that what your father told you when he left you behind? That you don't matter?

events.summary: Mia finds her sheep pen broken and a sheep missing.
events.quote: A quick count showed that one sheep was missing.

events.summary: Elder Kalim announces that he has seen the Gitrog and that fishing on the lake is suspended; he has written to the Church and suggests Mia write her father.
events.quote: The Elders convened last night, and we decree that fishing on the lake is suspended until further notice.

events.summary: Mia confesses she plans to join the Skiltfolk when she turns fifteen and shows Wilbur her silver crossbow; she agrees to take the threat seriously.
events.quote: I may not be a slayer yet, but I turn fifteen in just two months.

events.summary: Mia writes to her father for help, but receives no reply.
events.quote: Mia broke down and wrote her father, scrapping a dozen drafts before settling on a brief and formal missive asking for aid.

events.summary: The postal rider stops coming, and the rumor spreads that the Gitrog devoured the mail carrier.
events.quote: Within two days, accounts of the Gitrog devouring the mail carrier transformed from rumor to story to fact.

events.summary: More of Mia's sheep go missing, with the fence broken in different places each time.
events.quote: By first snowfall, three more sheep had gone missing.

events.summary: Armed hooded patrols begin walking the village streets as winter deepens.
events.quote: As winter deepened, armed men and women began patrolling the streets

events.summary: Mia and Wilbur quarrel bitterly; Wilbur accuses her of being afraid to leave for the Skiltfolk test, and she throws him out.
events.quote: You're scared. Scared you're all memorized rules and bluster.

events.summary: Mia spends a cold, lonely fifteenth birthday as snow falls, still estranged from Wilbur.
events.quote: What a perfect end to a cold and miserable birthday.

events.summary: Mia finds her entire flock slaughtered and her pen in tatters.
events.quote: Not one sheep remained.

events.summary: Mia finds huge webbed prints and drag marks leading toward the lake and takes them for the Gitrog.
events.quote: The imprint looked like a large, webbed foot, with three talon-like divots at one end.

events.summary: Mia decides to track the monster herself as her first step toward becoming a slayer.
events.quote: This was it. Her first step toward becoming a slayer.

events.summary: Mia discovers the tracks are faked by someone and follows human footprints to the lake.
events.quote: Someone had gone to the trouble of faking an attack, of making false prints, then sweeping away their tracks.

events.summary: Mia watches hooded villagers load sheep carcasses onto Lehren's ship and sees Wilbur among them.
events.quote: Wilbur gave one last lingering gaze into the woods before turning to board.

events.summary: Mia leaps onto the departing ship and clings to its stern ladder as it sails onto the fog-bound lake.
events.quote: hanging on the small ladder on the stern

events.summary: Kalim announces that the sheep of the slayer's daughter are being sacrificed to the Gitrog.
events.quote: Tonight we gift the Gitrog with the sheep of the slayer's daughter.

events.summary: Mia knocks out Lehren with her crossbow and confronts the hooded villagers as they toss carcasses overboard.
events.quote: dropped like a sack of potatoes

events.summary: Mia accuses the villagers of having killed her sheep a few at a time; Kalim insists everyone has seen the Gitrog and must feed it.
events.quote: There is no Gitrog! You destroyed my pen and slaughtered my herd!

events.summary: Mia demands that Kalim show her the Gitrog, and the villagers throw the carcasses into the lake.
events.quote: Show me your Gitrog.

events.summary: The Gitrog surfaces beside the boat and Mia sees it for the first time.
events.quote: As the water settled, she saw it. The monster. The Gitrog.

events.summary: The Gitrog's tongue hurls Veryl off the ship and he disappears into the water.
events.quote: Veryl went flying backward off the ship, screaming through the air, and disappeared with a splash into the water.

events.summary: Villagers, led by Sarah, turn on Mia and demand she be sacrificed to the Gitrog.
events.quote: Kill her! A sacrifice to the Gitrog!

events.summary: Mia fights off hooded attackers, including Kyle and Terrance, shooting one assailant in the stomach.
events.quote: The grip loosened and she turned around and fired blindly into the stomach of her assailant.

events.summary: Wilbur knocks out Terrance, apologizes that things got out of hand, and says he has only ever seen bubbles.
events.quote: I'm so sorry. Everything got out of hand.

events.summary: Kalim declares the only answer is sacrifice and tries to cut Mia's throat; Wilbur tackles him.
events.quote: Kalim lunged forward, fishing knife suddenly drawn and in his hand, swinging straight for Mia's throat.

events.summary: The Gitrog climbs aboard and devours Kalim just as he offers Mia in sacrifice.
events.quote: Mia watched in horror as Kalim's head disappeared into its gullet

events.summary: Mia sets the ship afire and dives into the icy lake with Wilbur, swimming back to shore.
events.quote: She turned forward and without a pause dove into the icy water, dragging Wilbur with her.

events.summary: The Gitrog follows them ashore and Mia falls into its gaze, seeing what she takes for truth.
events.quote: She saw truth in its blackest form, the clarity of a thousand lifetimes compressed into one moment.

events.summary: Mia, smiling, stabs Wilbur with her dagger as an offering.
events.quote: smiled as she slid her dagger out of its sheath and through his rib cage in one smooth motion.

events.summary: Mia bows to the Gitrog, declaring all is sacrifice, and it eats Wilbur's body.
events.quote: a monstrous tongue lapped out, grasping the body of the broken boy beside her.

events.summary: In spring a young postal apprentice arrives and Mia invites him to stay the night and offers to take him onto the lake.
events.quote: her eyes lit up when he mentioned the lake, and she invited him in to stay for the night

relations.note: In the Nephalian highlands near the Gavony border.
relations.quote: Dark and deep, Lake Zhava lies in the highlands of Nephalia
Father, I finally found some coriander!

relations.note: He has written to the Church of Avacyn for help.
relations.quote: I have also written to the Church of Avacyn for help.

relations.note: Daughter of the famed Skiltfolk shieldbearer who left her behind.
relations.quote: You don't think Olgard, famed Skiltfolk shieldbearer, would stand for the embarrassment of a daughter who couldn't defend herself, did you?

relations.note: Her growing, unspoken feelings for her friend.
It retreats to the lake after its attacks.
relations.quote: perhaps even catch sight of it before it slipped back into the lake

relations.note: It swallows him whole as he offers Mia.
relations.quote: Mia watched in horror as Kalim's head disappeared into its gullet

relations.note: Under the Gitrog's gaze she stabs him as a sacrifice.
relations.quote: smiled as she slid her dagger out of its sheath and through his rib cage in one smooth motion.

relations.note: Enthralled after its gaze, she hails it and offers sacrifice.
